data.change_summary: End-to-end rebalance pass completed for the scientific-core upgrade (v0.2-v0.6). Ran full calibration report against 8 validation scenarios: 6 pass, 2 marginal, 0 fail. Both marginal findings (vs01 cycling pH clamp at 8.5; vs08 crash shrimp_count=0 near zero boundary) are boundary-detection artifacts, not parameter deficiencies — no parameter tuning was needed. Created three deliverables: (1) docs/traces/calibration_snapshot_v0.6.md documenting the post-refactor tuning state with per-scenario analysis, (2) docs/RELEASE_NARRATIVE_v0.6.md tying each phase's changes back to the five structural weaknesses identified in the v0.1 gap analysis and describing new emergent behaviors, (3) a 10-item follow-on backlog covering envelope heuristic refinement, remaining provenance gaps (plant presets, routing fractions, thermal transport, substrate indices), microfauna routing parity, equipment auto-scaling, and sensitivity analysis tooling. Archived machine-readable calibration_report.json and calibration_summary.txt alongside the snapshot for future cross-run comparison.
outstanding_risks: The 10% marginal heuristic produces false positives on zero-bounded envelope fields (TAN, nitrite, shrimp_count near 0) — cosmetic noise in reports, not a model risk, but could mask real marginals in future scenarios with zero-bounded fields

pH gameplay clamp at 8.5 is a hard ceiling that prevents the carbonate solver from expressing equilibrium pH in high-buffer scenarios — affects vs01 presentation but not scientific validity since freshwater aquaria rarely exceed pH 8.5

Plant growth rate parameters (fast_stem: 0.08/day, root_rosette: 0.06/day) lack provenance metadata and are load-bearing for the algae-plant competition scenario (vs06, medium confidence) — a future literature search could shift these values and change vs06 outcome

Process routing fractions (shrimp assimilation 0.50, respiration 0.70, excretion 0.10, growth 0.20) are uncited heuristics that directly control how feeding rate translates to nutrient loading — sensitivity analysis should quantify their influence before making nutrient-budget claims
Microfauna routing remains a simpler approximation than shrimp routing, creating an asymmetry in mass-conservation rigor between the two consumer pathways
